subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas de divisão de um número natural por outro (até 10), com resto zero e com resto diferente de zero, com os significados de repartição equitativa e de medida, por meio de estratégias e registros pessoais.

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas de divisão com resto zero usando significados de repartição e medição
components.description_en: Solve division problems with zero remainder using equal-sharing and measurement meanings

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas de divisão com resto não nulo usando estratégias pessoais
components.description_en: Solve division problems with nonzero remainder using personal strategies
components.cc_component_description: Solve multi-step real-world problems using the four operations in situations where a remainder must be interpreted

components.description_pt: Representar o resto em um problema de divisão usando métodos pessoais de registro
components.description_en: Represent the remainder in a division problem using personal recording methods

components.description_pt: Compor uma situação de problema de divisão envolvendo um número inteiro dividido por outro até 10
components.description_en: Compose a division problem situation involving a whole number divided by another up to 10

cc_matches.description: Solve multistep word problems posed with whole numbers and having whole-number answers using the four operations, including problems in which remainders must be interpreted. Represent these problems using equations with a letter standing for the unknown quantity. Assess the reasonableness of answers using mental computation and estimation strategies including rounding.

Use multiplication and division within 100 to solve word problems in situations involving equal groups, arrays, and measurement quantities, e.g., by using drawings and equations with a symbol for the unknown number to represent the problem.
